channel.title: Groups on P-SSCRM: Proactive Secure Software Supply Chain Risk Management
channel.description: Recent content in Groups on P-SSCRM: Proactive Secure Software Supply Chain Risk Management

item.title: Governance
item.description: Controls that focus on the organization, measurement of a secure software supply chain, decision-making policies, accountability to third-party obligations, and compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.

item.title: Product
item.description: Controls to lead to deploying a secure product with minimal vulnerabilities with associated required attestations and artifacts.

item.title: Environment
item.description: Controls to protect the confidentiality and integrity of source code, software components, and the build infrastructure from tampering and unauthorized access.

item.title: Deployment
item.description: Controls for identifying, analyzing, and addressing vulnerabilities in products in production/that have been deployed

item.title: Unassigned
item.description: Controls that have been identified but not associated with a framework
